facts.fact: Caroline 日记 2017-12-28：Arthur 带着已故狗 Bailey 的牵引绳和网球出门
facts.anchor: Arthur’s gone out with Bailey’s lead

facts.fact: Caroline 劝 Arthur 再养一条狗，他只是盯着她像她疯了
facts.anchor: I’ve tried to get him to think about getting another dog

facts.fact: 八年间子女 Greg 和 Lucy 只来看望过一次
facts.anchor: even their children had only stayed with them once

facts.fact: 山间道路被雪封了几周，Lucy 说可能三个月后才能再来
facts.anchor: the road has been cut off for weeks

facts.fact: 男主亲手把 Caroline 的衣物全部送去了衣物回收站
facts.anchor: He’d taken them all to the clothing bank

facts.fact: 回归的衣物里包括 Burberry 雨衣、晚礼服和被虫蛀的丝绸羊绒
短信与衣柜低语都用同一句话你就这样躲着是不行的
facts.anchor: You can’t just hide away like this

facts.fact: 结尾 Caroline 的声音直接呼唤 Arthur 的名字问他能否听见
